title: Consume European Star Cross indirect records
changes: Extend the existing indirect-record owner to serve three Star Cross records while preserving earlier observation masks and guest pointer/count behavior.
validation: Wine k4a2e7il preserves earlier representation and 147 other resources, rejects coherent edits, and verifies mirrors/boundaries, snapshot ownership and 44 interpreter/generated reader, fallback and caller cases.
Wine a47ngrrg matches all 480 frames with all three records altered and observes each record served. Wine _c1pwxal creates, reuses and verifies 149 matching E296 files; all servers drained.
limitations: One continuation does not prove exact scene PCs, every caller, guest pointer/count domains or real BIOS. Other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; revision-sensitive older Wine fixtures are listed for recovery. No performance comparison was made.
